screen.audiozone.title: Audio Zone
audiozone.ui.tab.usage: Press Enter to open this tab. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs.
audiozone.ui.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
audiozone.ui.unsaved.message: You have changes that are not saved. Save them before closing?
audiozone.demo.title: UI kit demo
audiozone.demo.why: Why does this sound like this?
audiozone.demo.slider_keys: Slider keys: Left/Right step 5, Shift+Left/Right step 1.
audiozone.demo.delete_message: "Trading hall" and its 3 rules will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
audiozone.demo.help_message: Every control here can be used with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs. Esc closes dialogs with the safest choice.
audiozone.demo.error.volume: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200
audiozone.demo.tip.bypass: Demo only: in Audio Zone this plays every sound as in vanilla, ignoring all rules.
audiozone.demo.tip.plain_button: An ordinary text button. Pressing it updates "Last action".
audiozone.demo.tip.disabled_button: A disabled button: it cannot be pressed and Tab skips it.
audiozone.demo.tip.show_cue: Show a short on-screen cue when a muted sound plays.
audiozone.demo.tip.reduced_motion: Turn off list animations and toast slide-ins.
audiozone.demo.tip.volume_slider: Volume from 0 to 200%%. Above 100%% is louder than vanilla.
audiozone.demo.tip.volume_typed: Type a volume from 0 to 200; the slider follows.
audiozone.demo.tip.pattern: A sound ID pattern. * matches any text, e.g. minecraft:entity.villager.*
audiozone.demo.tip.open_two: Opens a dialog with two choices. Esc picks Cancel.
audiozone.demo.tip.open_three: Opens a dialog with three choices. Esc picks Keep editing.
audiozone.demo.tip.pretend_unsaved: When on, closing this screen asks whether to save first.
audiozone.ui.list.usage: Press Tab to enter the list. Up and Down move between rows, Left and Right between buttons, Page Up and Page Down by a page. Tab again leaves the list.
audiozone.ui.dropdown.usage: Press Enter to choose. Up and Down move, Enter picks, Esc cancels.
audiozone.ui.color.swatch.usage: Press Enter to choose this color
audiozone.demo.tip.refresh: Simulates new sounds arriving. The focused row and the scroll position stay put.
audiozone.demo.tip.apply_to: Where a new rule goes: everywhere, or into one zone.
audiozone.demo.tip.show_undo_toast: Shows a message with an Undo button for 5 seconds.
audiozone.recent.pause.tip: Freeze the list so you can read it. Shortcut: P while the list has focus.
audiozone.recent.sort.name: Name
audiozone.recent.filter.hint: Filter by name, ID or category
audiozone.recent.empty: No sounds yet. Sounds you hear appear here.
audiozone.settings.show_distance.tip: Show how far away each recently played sound was (Close, Near, Far). Turn off for servers that object to distance hints.
audiozone.bypass.tip: Turn every Audio Zone effect off at once (vanilla sound) without changing any rule. Hotkey: %s (on laptops you may need Fn+F10).
audiozone.settings.bypass_hint: Bypass hotkey: %s. On laptops you may need Fn+F10.
audiozone.notice.profile_broken.title: Audio Zone profile could not be loaded
audiozone.notice.profile_broken.message: %s It was renamed to .broken and an empty profile is used.
audiozone.notice.save_failed.title: Audio Zone could not save
audiozone.notice.errors.title: Audio Zone turned itself off
audiozone.notice.errors.message: Too many errors, so Bypass is on and sounds play as in vanilla. Please report this bug.
audiozone.rules.add.tip: Create a rule for one sound or a family of sounds, for example minecraft:entity.villager.*
audiozone.rules.hint: More specific patterns win. On a tie, the rule higher in the list wins.
audiozone.rules.empty: No rules yet. Use Add rule, or Mute on the Recently Played tab.
audiozone.rules.turn_off: Turn this rule off without deleting it
audiozone.rules.delete.title: Delete this rule?
audiozone.rules.delete.message: The rule for %s will be deleted. To keep it for later, turn it off instead.
audiozone.rule_editor.pattern.tip: Type words to find a sound (villager hurt, cow|sheep, -ambient), then pick one; or type a sound ID or a pattern where * stands for any characters, such as minecraft:entity.villager.*
audiozone.rule_editor.enabled.tip: Turn the rule off to stop its effect without deleting it
audiozone.rule_editor.mute.tip: Muted silences matching sounds. Not muted overrides a broader rule that mutes them. Unchanged leaves it to other rules and shows what the sound gets now.
audiozone.rule_editor.volume.tip: Loudness of matching sounds, on top of Minecraft's own volume sliders. Arrow keys change it by 5%%, Shift+arrow by 1%%.
audiozone.rule_editor.volume_typed.tip: Type 0 to 100, or leave it empty to leave the volume unchanged (the faint number is what the sound gets now)
audiozone.rule_editor.matches.invalid: Fix the pattern to see which sounds it matches
audiozone.rule_editor.matches.none: No known sound matches yet. Sounds added later by mods still can.
audiozone.pattern.error.empty: Type a sound ID or a pattern
audiozone.pattern.error.empty_part: Type something before and after the :
audiozone.summary.rule.limit_per_source: At most %1$s per %2$s s, per source
audiozone.boost.confirm.title: Louder than vanilla?
audiozone.boost.confirm.body: Above 100%% the sound is louder than vanilla can play it. Loud sounds may crackle or distort, and long exposure can harm your hearing. Boost never lets you hear a sound from farther away.
audiozone.boost.unsupported: Your audio device does not support boost, so volume stops at 100%%.
audiozone.trace.notice.bypass: Bypass is on: nothing is changed.
audiozone.trace.notice.vanilla_covered: This sound has its own vanilla slider, so Audio Zone does not handle it.
audiozone.trace.notice.not_heard_yet: Not heard yet; zones depend on where it plays.
audiozone.trace.notice.changed_since_pla: Rules or zones changed since this sound last played, so what you heard may differ.
audiozone.trace.zone_reason.tie_smaller_: Tie on distance; smaller zone wins
audiozone.trace.zone_reason.tie_list_ord: Tie on distance and size; higher in the list
audiozone.trace.text.play_dropped: Last play was dropped by the repeat limit
audiozone.trace.edit.error.limit_window_: Window must be from %1$s to %2$s ms
audiozone.trace.edit.error.too_many_rule: This list already has the most rules allowed
audiozone.trace.edit.volume.tip: Change this rule's volume. Changes apply at once and can be undone.
audiozone.trace.edit.volume_typed.tip: Type a volume, or leave it empty so this rule does not set one
audiozone.trace.edit.add_rule.tip: Add a rule for this exact sound to the global rules
audiozone.trace.edit.add_rule.zone_tip: Add a rule for this exact sound to this zone
audiozone.trace.edit.undo_stale: Not undone: it was changed again since
audiozone.recent.why: Why does it sound like this?
audiozone.diag.per_sound: Time per sound: average %s µs, max %s µs (peak %s µs)
audiozone.diag.tick: Re-checking playing sounds: average %s µs, max %s µs per tick
audiozone.diag.outlines: Zone outlines: average %s µs, max %s µs per frame
audiozone.diag.cache.none: Pattern cache hit rate: no sounds yet
audiozone.diag.copy.tip: Copy these numbers with the mod and Minecraft versions, for a bug report
audiozone.trace.title: Why does it sound like this?
audiozone.trace.copy.tip: Copy this trace as plain text, for asking for help or reporting a bug
audiozone.search.help.2: villager hurt: contains all the words
audiozone.search.help.4: villager hurt | zombie hurt: | splits into groups; spaces inside a group mean all
audiozone.search.empty: No sound matches. Try fewer or shorter words.
audiozone.zones.new.tip: Create a 10-block box where you stand, then mark its corners or adjust its sides
audiozone.zones.hint: Zones change sounds inside them. Overlaps: the closest center wins.
audiozone.zones.empty: No zones yet. Use New zone where you want sounds changed.
audiozone.zones.turn_off: Turn this zone off without deleting it
audiozone.zones.rules.tip: The rules this zone applies to sounds inside it
audiozone.zones.delete.title: Delete this zone?
audiozone.zones.delete.message: The zone %s and its rules will be deleted. To keep it for later, turn it off instead.
audiozone.zone_rules.title: Zone rules
audiozone.zone_rules.subtitle: Zone: %s
audiozone.zone_rules.empty: No rules yet. Use Add rule; the pattern * means every sound in the zone.
audiozone.zone_editor.rules.tip: Save the zone and edit the rules it applies
audiozone.zone_editor.enabled.tip: Turn the zone off to stop its effect without deleting it
audiozone.zone_editor.my_position.tip: Center the zone where you stand
audiozone.zone_editor.looking_at.tip: Center the zone on the block you are looking at
audiozone.zone_editor.shape.tip: A sphere around the center, or a box aligned with the world grid
audiozone.zone_editor.name: Zone name
audiozone.zone_editor.name.tip: Shown in the zone list, in Recently Played and above the zone's outline
audiozone.settings.outlines.tip: Draw zones in the world: always, only the zone open in the zone editor, or never. Hotkey: %s.
audiozone.settings.through_blocks.tip: Draw outlines and names on top of blocks, so you can see zones behind walls. They are your own zones, so this shows nothing about the world.
audiozone.rules.add_existing.tip: Copy a rule from the global list or another zone into this zone. The copy is separate: changing one later does not change the other.
audiozone.rule_copy.title: Add existing rule
audiozone.rule_copy.hint: Copies are separate: changing one later does not change the other.
audiozone.rule_copy.empty: No other rules yet. Rules from the global list and other zones show here.
audiozone.rule_copy.copy.tip: Add a copy of this rule to this zone
audiozone.rule_copy.duplicate: This zone already has a rule for this pattern; edit that one instead
audiozone.no_world: Join a world or server to see and change its sounds. Each one keeps its own rules and zones.
audiozone.settings.no_world: The other settings belong to a world or server; join one to change them.
audiozone.zone_editor.mark_corners.tip: Close this editor, then left-click a block (or press %s) for each of the two corners; looking at nothing marks the block you stand in. The box between them becomes the zone.
audiozone.zone_editor.side.tip: The side Grow and Shrink move; the opposite side stays where it is
audiozone.zone_editor.shrink.tip: Move the chosen side in by 1 block (Shift: 5 blocks)
audiozone.zone_editor.grow.tip: Move the chosen side out by 1 block (Shift: 5 blocks)
audiozone.zone_editor.size_label: Size in blocks: width (x), height (y), depth (z)
audiozone.marking.controls: Left-click a block (or press %1$s) to mark it · %2$s cancels
audiozone.rule_editor.search.many: %1$s sounds match "%2$s" · pick This sound or Like this
audiozone.rule_editor.search.one: 1 sound matches "%2$s" · pick This sound or Like this
audiozone.rule_editor.search.none: No sound matches "%2$s" · try other words
audiozone.rule_editor.this_sound.tip: Make the rule for exactly this sound
audiozone.rule_editor.like_this.tip: Make the rule for a family of sounds like this one; choose how wide
audiozone.profiles.hint: Each server and world has its own profile.
audiozone.profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Join a server or world to make one.
audiozone.profiles.folder_fallback: This save is read-only, so its profile uses the folder name.
audiozone.profiles.copy.tip: Copy this profile's global rules, bubbles and settings into this world's profile
audiozone.profiles.copy.title: Copy from %s?
audiozone.profiles.copy.message: Its %1$s global rules, %2$s bubble zones and settings will replace this world's. This world's %3$s fixed zones stay. Fixed zones are never copied.
audiozone.profiles.rename.title: Rename profile
audiozone.profiles.rename.name: Name
audiozone.profiles.rename.name.tip: The name shown for this profile. Its server or world stays the same.
audiozone.profiles.reset.title: Reset this profile?
audiozone.profiles.reset.message: All rules, zones and settings of %s will be removed. This can't be undone.
audiozone.profiles.delete.current: This world's profile can't be deleted. Reset it instead.
audiozone.profiles.delete.title: Delete this profile?
audiozone.profiles.delete.message: The profile %s will be deleted. Joining that server or world again starts a new, empty profile.
audiozone.profiles.own: Give this copy its own profile
audiozone.profiles.own.tip: If you copied this world's save folder, the copy shares the original's profile. This gives the copy its own.
audiozone.profiles.own.title: Give this world its own profile?
audiozone.profiles.own.message: This world gets its own copy of the current rules, zones and settings. The original world keeps the shared profile.
audiozone.profiles.own.done: This world now has its own profile
audiozone.profiles.own.failed: Could not write the world's ID file, so nothing changed
audiozone.transfer.export.tip: Save this profile as a file in config/audiozone/exports, fixed zones included
audiozone.transfer.exported.title: Profile exported
audiozone.transfer.open_imports.tip: Open config/audiozone/imports. Put profile files there to import them.
audiozone.transfer.import_button.tip: Import a profile file into this world's profile. You can also drop a file on this tab.
audiozone.transfer.import_screen.title: Import a profile
audiozone.transfer.import_screen.empty: No files yet. Put a .json file in the folder, or drop one on the Profiles tab.
audiozone.transfer.import.tip: Check this file and see what it will change
audiozone.transfer.import.title: Import %s?
audiozone.transfer.import.replace: Its %1$s global rules, %2$s bubble zones and settings will replace this world's.
audiozone.transfer.import.fixed: %s fixed zones made for this server will be added.
audiozone.transfer.import.skipped: %s fixed zones made for another server will be skipped.
audiozone.transfer.import.ignored: %s unknown settings in the file will be ignored.
audiozone.transfer.imported.skipped: Imported %1$s. %2$s fixed zones were skipped (another server).
audiozone.transfer.no_world: Join a world or server to import into its profile
audiozone.transfer.problem.title: Can't import %s
audiozone.profile.problem.value.not_date: %s is not a date and time like 2026-11-09T13:37:46Z
audiozone.profile.problem.not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
audiozone.profile.problem.not_json_at: The file is not valid JSON (line %1$s, column %2$s).
audiozone.profile.problem.not_profile: The file is not a profile (expected a JSON object).
audiozone.profile.problem.not_allowed: A value in the file is not allowed.
audiozone.profile.problem.too_many_zones: The file has %1$s zones; the maximum is %2$s.
audiozone.profile.problem.too_many_rules: The file has %1$s rules; the maximum is %2$s.
audiozone.profile.problem.too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
audiozone.profile.problem.unreadable: The file could not be read: %s
audiozone.profile.problem.not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 text.
audiozone.profile.problem.newer: This file was made with a newer Audio Zone (schema %s). Update the mod to use it.
audiozone.profile.problem.newer_import: This file was made with a newer Audio Zone. Update the mod to import it.
audiozone.profile.problem.backup_failed: The file could not be backed up before upgrading it: %s
audiozone.profile.problem.import_too_man: After the import this profile would have %1$s zones; the maximum is %2$s.
audiozone.profile.problem.copy_too_many_: After copying this profile would have %1$s zones; the maximum is %2$s.
audiozone.profile.problem.name_too_long: The name can be at most %s characters.
